title: Language Model Conversion
summary: Facilitates the conversion of various language model checkpoints from different original frameworks and formats into Hugging Face's Transformers library compatible models.

nodes.label: Gemma Family Conversions
nodes.title: Gemma Family Model Conversions
nodes.description: Handles the conversion of various Gemma-family model checkpoints to the Hugging Face format, including Gemma2, Gemma3, Gemma3n, Gemma4, Recurrent Gemma, ShieldGemma2, and Paligemma.

nodes.label: Text Model Conversions
nodes.title: Text Model Conversions
nodes.description: Converts checkpoints for a wide range of text-based models like BART, BigBird, Bloom, Electra, GPT-2, LLama, Marian, Mistral, T5, and many others to the Hugging Face Transformers format.

nodes.label: Vision Model Conversions
nodes.title: Vision Model Conversions
nodes.description: Manages the conversion of checkpoints for various vision models, including those for object detection (DETR, Grounding DINO), image classification (Swin, EfficientNet), and segmentation (MaskFormer, SAM) to Hugging Face format.

nodes.label: Multimodal Model Conversions
nodes.title: Multimodal Model Conversions
nodes.description: Facilitates the conversion of models that combine multiple modalities like text, image, and audio (e.g., BLIP, InstructBLIP, LLava, Mimi, Music Flamingo) into the Hugging Face ecosystem.

nodes.label: Audio Model Conversions
nodes.title: Audio Model Conversions
nodes.description: Converts checkpoints for audio-specific models such as Audio Spectrogram Transformer, Audio Flamingo, FastSpeech2, Higgs Audio, and Parakeet into the Hugging Face format.

nodes.label: Model Architectures
nodes.title: External Model Architectures
nodes.description: Represents the definitions and structures of various language models, which are consumed by the conversion processes.

groups.label: Model Converters
groups.title: Core Model Conversion Logic
groups.description: Contains the specialized logic and functions for converting diverse model checkpoints into a unified Hugging Face format.
